## Definition of Done
- [ ] Traces to a requirement / ADR / defect / change request
- [ ] `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, `mypy`, `pytest --cov` (≥ 85 %) pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated (a passing and a failing case for every new check)
- [ ] Docs updated (CLI contract, metric catalog, test cases, runbooks as relevant)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under *Unreleased*
- [ ] Deployment artefacts validated (compose config / promtool / shellcheck), if touched
- [ ] Hardware change: TC-HW cases to re-run are listed below
